logs.summary: First day. Pilot recruited, branch cockpit created, cockpit scaffolded, flightcrew surveyed, settings and messaging learned and tested, launcher and write guard built, incubator opened.
In progress. Fable launcher, records vs notepad, crew protocol and manifest, first agent team, persona moved to quarters, guard rewrite.

CLAUDE.md repaired: rules, crew protocol and session procedures moved back from quarters after an Opus judge; quarters trimmed to persona. Crew rules 2 and 6 corrected on the commander's orders. Workshop opened with seven items; missions scoped to bigger work.

Callsign Ace. Recon team T001, research team T002, critics T003/T008, topics-and-records team T006. Commander's desk opened; dossiers DS001 to DS003; work split, dispatch room, orders.json, topics store (27 topics, 203 statements), records docspec (one topic whole, 100/150), seven records drafted awaiting P009. Teams integrated: rosters, crew rooms, 20 dossiers. Session log exceeded the cap set mid-session; two-line entries from the next session.

DS003 advice (D020) led to decision team T009 on record keeping: DS004/P010 approved and executed (rule 2 rewritten, one header line per record, harness register and four stubs landed). Procedures room designed and built (O042, DS005/P011, O043): five cockpit procedures live, manifest imported into CLAUDE.md. S009 promoted to mission M002 (horizon). P012 raised to guard unmerged branches. Two commits pushed.
